title: 第23章 夜探石楼，邂逅镜中人
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
夜色浓稠如墨。

    苏余没有等天亮。

    他和林霜约定在镇北三十里外的枯柳坡汇合，然后独自一人摸了回去。

    走之前林霜看着他，只说了两个字：“别死。”

    苏余没有回答，将一块从铁剑门护法身上搜来的隐息玉佩挂在腰间，闪身没入夜色之中。

    黑石镇在黑暗中安静得像一座坟场。

    苏余在屋顶上无声穿行，隐息玉佩让他的气息降低到了炼气初期的水平，再加上易容膏和粗布衣袍，任谁看到都只会觉得是个偷鸡摸狗的流浪汉。

    他在镇中央的石楼对面停下，伏在屋顶的阴影中朝石楼望去。

    石楼门口守着两个筑基初期的修士，是天机阁雇佣的散修护卫，正百无聊赖地打着哈欠。

    苏余没有从正门走，绕到石楼后院，翻过一堵土墙，落在一堆杂物之中。

    石楼一层是个宽阔的大厅，摆满了桌椅，是拍卖前用来登记和交易的场所。

    二层往上才是天机阁的核心区域。

    苏余在杂物堆中摸到了通往后厨的窄门，门没锁。

    他闪身进入后厨，沿着灶台边的窄梯向上攀爬。

    木质楼梯在他脚下发出轻微的吱呀声，他每走一步都停顿一息，将体重从左脚换到右脚再换到左脚，像一头在密林中悄悄靠近猎物的豹子。

    时之种在改变他的身体——不只是时痕积累速度提升，还有对时间流速的感知精度。

    过去他需要刻意控制才能不发出声响，现在这种控制变成了本能，每一个关节、每一块肌肉都像被他完全驯服的猎犬，忠实地执行着他的意志。

    二楼走廊尽头的房间里透出微弱的灯火。

    苏余贴着走廊墙壁无声地移动到门边，从门缝中往里看去。

    房间里只有一个人——天机阁传信使周白。

    他已经脱下了白天的正式衣袍，换了一身便服，正坐在桌前用一支细小的符笔在一枚传音玉符上写着什么。

    桌面上摊着几张写满字的纸，旁边放着半壶灵茶和一碟点心。

    苏余将手按在归字剑的剑柄上。

    时间爆破随时可以发动——十息寿命换来一息绝对静止，足够他冲进房间、制住周白、拿到桌上的所有纸张、原路返回。

    但他没有动手。

    周白是炼气九层，与他之前杀过的所有修士都不一样——不是修为高低的区别，而是周白身上有一种让他汗毛微竖的危险感。

    那种感觉不是灵力威压，也不是杀意，而是一种更深层的、被人在暗处窥视的不适。

    时之种赋予他的时之共鸣正在发出微弱的警示——这个房间里不止周白一个人。

    苏余将呼吸压得更低，将时之共鸣的感知精度提升到极限。

    他“看见”了——周白身后的墙壁上挂着一面铜镜。

    铜镜本身平平无奇，但镜面中隐约映出一个黑色的人形轮廓。

    那个人形轮廓不是周白的倒影——周白的倒影是坐在桌前的，而镜中的人形是站着的，就站在周白身后不到三步远的位置，无声无息，像一个影子。

    苏余没有动。

    他继续静静地看着房间里的一切。

    大约过了半盏茶功夫，周白写完了传音符上的内容，将符纸折叠封好，站起身来朝门外走去。
content_en:
The night was as thick as ink.

    Su Yu didn't wait for dawn.

    He and Lin Shuang agreed to meet at Dry Willow Slope, thirty miles north of the town, and then went back alone.

    Before leaving, Lin Shuang looked at him and said only two words: "Don't die."

    Su Yu didn't answer. He hung a hidden jade pendant that he had found from the body of the Iron Sword Sect protector on his waist and disappeared into the night.

    Blackstone Town was as quiet as a cemetery in the darkness.

    Su Yu walked silently on the roof. The Hidden Breath Jade Pendant lowered his aura to the level of the early stage of Qi refining. Coupled with the disguise cream and coarse cloth robes, anyone who saw him would just think he was a sneaky vagabond.

    He stopped opposite the stone building in the center of the town, crouched in the shadow of the roof and looked towards the stone building.

    Guarding the door of the stone building were two monks who were in the early stages of foundation building. They were casual cultivators employed by Tianji Pavilion, and they were yawning out of boredom.

    Su Yu did not go through the main entrance, but went around to the backyard of the stone building, climbed over an earth wall, and landed among a pile of debris.

    The first floor of the stone building is a wide hall filled with tables and chairs, which is used for registration and transactions before the auction.

    The core area of ​​Tianji Pavilion is from the second floor up.

    Su Yu found the narrow door leading to the back kitchen among the debris. The door was unlocked.

    He ducked into the back kitchen and climbed up the narrow ladder beside the stove.

    The wooden stairs creaked slightly under his feet. He paused every step and shifted his weight from left foot to right foot and then to left foot, like a leopard sneaking up on its prey in a dense forest.

    The Seed of Time is changing his body - not only the accumulation speed of time traces is increasing, but also the accuracy of sensing the flow of time.

    In the past, he needed to deliberately control not to make any noise, but now this control has become instinctive, and every joint and every muscle is like a hound that has been completely tamed by him, faithfully executing his will.

    There was a faint light coming from the room at the end of the corridor on the second floor.

    Su Yu moved silently against the corridor wall to the door and looked in through the crack in the door.

    There was only one person in the room—Zhou Bai, the messenger from Tianji Pavilion.

    He had taken off his formal robes during the day and changed into casual clothes. He was sitting at the table and writing something on a sound-transmitting jade talisman with a small talisman pen.

    There were several sheets of paper covered with writing spread out on the table, with half a pot of spiritual tea and a plate of snacks beside them.

    Su Yu put his hand on the hilt of the Gui Zi Sword.

    Time blast can be activated at any time - ten breaths of life in exchange for one breath of absolute stillness, enough for him to rush into the room, restrain Zhou Bai, get all the papers on the table, and return the way he came.

    But he didn't take action.

    Zhou Bai was at the ninth level of Qi Refining, and was different from all the monks he had killed before - it was not the difference in cultivation level, but the sense of danger in Zhou Bai that made his hair stand on end.

    That feeling was not spiritual pressure or murderous intent, but a deeper discomfort of being peeped in the dark.

    The Time Resonance given to him by the Time Seed was sending out a faint warning - Zhou Bai was not the only one in this room.

    Su Yu lowered his breathing and raised the perception accuracy of the resonance of time to the limit.

    He "saw" a bronze mirror hanging on the wall behind Zhou Bai.

    The bronze mirror itself is unremarkable, but a black human figure is vaguely reflected in the mirror.

    The silhouette of the human figure was not Zhou Bai's reflection - Zhou Bai's reflection was sitting at the table, but the human figure in the mirror was standing, standing less than three steps behind Zhou Bai, silently, like a shadow.

    Su Yu didn't move.

    He continued to look at everything in the room quietly.

    After about half a cup of tea, Zhou Bai finished writing the contents of the transmission talisman, folded and sealed the talisman paper, stood up and walked out the door.
title_en: Chapter 23 Exploring the stone tower at night and meeting the man in the mirror
